indexes.name: uq_go_device_role_parent_name
keys:
((
CASE
    WHEN parent_id IS NULL THEN '0'::text
    ELSE parent_id::text
END || ':'::text) || name::text)

indexes.name: uq_go_device_role_parent_slug
keys:
((
CASE
    WHEN parent_id IS NULL THEN '0'::text
    ELSE parent_id::text
END || ':'::text) || slug::text)

indexes.name: uq_go_device_rack_position_face
indexes.predicate: rack_id IS NOT NULL AND "position" IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: chk_go_ip_assignment_pair
constraints.expression: assigned_object_type IS NULL AND assigned_object_id IS NULL OR assigned_object_type::text = 'dcim.interface'::text AND assigned_object_id IS NOT NULL
